text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: Dear Mom and Dad, I'm writing this from Sapporo. It feels kind of similar to Morioka here, so I feel weirdly at home.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: The people here know about the Snow Angel thing too, but this time…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: This time, at the Queen Stakes, I wanted to win their hearts with my racing!
